reviewer: v13_seq_telemetry_review sub-agent: independent CPU scalar artifact inspection (no new model computation)

units_and_formulas.energy_direction: sum(dot(local_action,D))/sum(||D||^2); row targets zero retained in action/error energy
units_and_formulas.energy_relative_error: sqrt(sum(||action-D||^2)/sum(||D||^2)); not arithmetic mean of ratios
units_and_formulas.row_ratio_quantiles: all nonzero-target slots without tiny-target exclusion; zero rows separately counted/leakage
units_and_formulas.groups: mean has one request/layer; canonical one request/layer; rewrite six native rows/request/layer; KL one row/request/layer (runtime verified this run, not universal adapter hardcode)
units_and_formulas.shares: mean/canonical owner is request index; contexts.owner is context-row index and context_owners maps to request
units_and_formulas.Q: new batch update cost in own entry metric, not cumulative endpoint norm; do not sum nested timers
units_and_formulas.storage: sum logical st_size of existing regular output files, not peak filesystem reserve/allocated blocks

provenance.scope: Read-only exact existing attempt MD/CD scalar JSON and fit-event records, no GPU/model load/forward/new evaluation/scheduler request/transfer/source mutation
limitations: Stored numerical parity flags and scalar residuals reviewed, not recomputed from discarded tensors; no checkpoint/replay possible.
Allocation wall and CPU collector final accounting supplied separately by owner single accounting snapshot; this file preserves CPU-record wall timings only.
Local action, inherited gap, final virtual gap and net entry displacement are distinct; directional/local realization is not quality proof.
Near-zero nonzero D makes unweighted ratio tails unstable; no rows excluded.
No new baseline comparison or raw/prompt/tensor publication.
